requirements.text: When the driver switches the ACC main switch on, the AccController shall enter STANDBY.

When the driver presses Set in STANDBY with the brake pedal released and an ego speed of at least 30 km/h, the AccController shall enter ACTIVE with the set speed equal to the current ego speed rounded to the nearest km/h.
If the driver presses Set or Resume at an ego speed below 30 km/h, then the AccController shall remain in STANDBY.
When the driver presses Resume in STANDBY with a stored set speed, the brake pedal released and an ego speed of at least 30 km/h, the AccController shall enter ACTIVE with the stored set speed.
When the driver presses Speed Up or Speed Down in ACTIVE or OVERRIDE, the AccController shall change the set speed by 5 km/h, limited to the range 30 km/h to 180 km/h.
When the driver presses the brake pedal or Cancel in ACTIVE or OVERRIDE, the AccController shall enter STANDBY within one cycle and keep the set speed stored.
When the driver presses the accelerator pedal beyond 5 % in ACTIVE, the AccController shall enter OVERRIDE and request neither acceleration nor braking until the pedal is released.
When the driver switches the ACC main switch off, the AccController shall enter OFF and clear the set speed.
If the ego speed falls below 25 km/h in ACTIVE, then the AccController shall enter STANDBY.
While ACTIVE without a relevant target, the AccController shall control the ego speed to the set speed with a steady-state error of at most 1 km/h.

While ACTIVE with a relevant target, the AccController shall control the distance to the target to 5 m plus the selected time gap multiplied by the ego speed, with a steady-state error of at most 2 m, and shall not exceed the set speed.
The AccController shall offer the time gap settings 1, 2 and 3 corresponding to 1.0 s, 1.5 s and 2.0 s.
The AccController shall treat a radar object as the relevant target only if it is valid, at most 200 m ahead and at most 1.8 m from the ego lane centre.
The AccController shall limit the requested acceleration to 2.0 m/s2 and the requested deceleration to 3.5 m/s2.
While ACTIVE, the AccController shall limit the change of the requested longitudinal acceleration to 2.5 m/s3 when it increases and 5.0 m/s3 when it decreases.
If a relevant target that is followed at the selected time gap decelerates at up to 3 m/s2, or a slower vehicle cuts in at 25 m or more, then the AccController shall keep the distance above 5 m.
The AccController shall never request acceleration and braking at the same time.
The AccController shall always request a steering angle of 0 deg.
While not ACTIVE, the AccController shall request neither acceleration nor braking.
The AccController shall send the AccCommand message every 20 ms with E2E protection and report its mode, set speed and time gap setting in it.

If no valid RadarObject frame is received for 120 ms, or no valid EgoState or DriverInput frame for 60 ms, then the AccController shall enter FAULT, where frames failing the E2E check count as not received.
While in FAULT, the AccController shall remain in FAULT until the driver switches the ACC main switch off.

tests.name: S01_MainSwitchOnEntersSTANDBYWithoutRequestingAccelerationOrBrak
tests.scenario: Main switch on enters STANDBY without requesting acceleration or braking

steps.text: Given the ego vehicle drives at 100 km/h
When the driver switches ACC on
Then the ACC state is STANDBY
And neither acceleration nor braking is requested

tests.name: S02_SetEngagesAtTheCurrentSpeedRoundedToTheNearestKmH
tests.scenario: Set engages at the current speed rounded to the nearest km/h

steps.text: Given the ego vehicle drives at 87.4 km/h
And the driver switches ACC on
When the driver presses the set button
Then the ACC state is ACTIVE
And the set speed is 87 km/h
And the reported time gap setting is 2

tests.name: S03_SetIsIgnoredWhileTheBrakePedalIsPressed

steps.text: Given the ego vehicle drives at 100 km/h
And the driver switches ACC on
And the driver presses the brake pedal
When the driver presses the set button
Then the ACC state is STANDBY

tests.name: S04_ReleasingTheBrakeWhileSetIsStillHeldDoesNotEngage

steps.text: Given the ego vehicle drives at 100 km/h

And the driver presses the brake pedal
When the driver releases the brake pedal while holding the set button
Then the ACC state is STANDBY

tests.name: S06_EngagementIsRefusedBelow30KmH_Ex2

Then the ACC state is STANDBY
And the set speed is 100 km/h
When the ego vehicle drives at 80 km/h
And the driver presses the resume button

And neither acceleration nor braking is requested
When 2 s pass
And the driver releases the accelerator pedal

Then the set speed is 120 km/h

And the requested acceleration never exceeded 2.0 m/s2
And the requested jerk never exceeded 2.5 m/s3 increasing and 5.0 m/s3 decreasing
